title: gitlab: 19.0.4 -> 19.2.2
reason: Applicable: changed-file list includes nixos/modules/services/misc/gitlab/default.nix (plus release notes, gitaly/gitlab-shell/gitlab-workhorse/gitlab package.nix/data.json/rubyEnv files -- package-only/version-data). This is NOT a pure package-hash bump with zero module changes: default.nix's own systemd.tmpfiles.rules gains one new line, `"d ${gitlabConfig.production.shared.path}/agent_plan_content 0750 ${cfg.user} ${cfg.group} -"`, using existing cfg.* references -- no mkOption/mkEnableOption/mkRenamedOptionModule declaration line is touched. Wired test confirmed indirectly: nixos/tests/all-tests.nix at head (52de0c604) has `gitlab = import ./gitlab { inherit runTest; };` (line 694), and nixos/tests/gitlab/default.nix (fetched, content: `{ runTest }: { gitlab = runTest ./gitlab.nix; runner = runTest ./runner.nix; }`) confirms nixos/tests/gitlab/gitlab.nix is the real, wired test -- this is exactly the 'nested/indirect test file' case the task warned a shallow search could miss. Only baseline `enable` was watched.
targets_toml: single target gitlab, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,gitlab], watch=[enable].
